after.zh: 颜色可以通过各通道之间的关系区分：即使整体明暗接近，蓝和黄也能呈现不同的通道组合。不同的滤波器可以关注不同的颜色对比。
after.en: Colours can be distinguished by the relationships among channels: blue and yellow have different channel combinations even at similar overall brightness. Different filters can focus on different colour contrasts.

t.zh: <level-ref to="4-12"></level-ref>的核分辨的是红和绿。颜色还有另一组对立：蓝和黄。沙漠的天际线、海边的沙滩，交界两边常常一样亮，只是颜色不同。
t.en: The kernel in <level-ref to="4-12"></level-ref> told red from green. Colour has another opposition: blue and yellow. On a desert skyline or a beach, the two sides of the border are often equally bright and differ only in colour.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="lrn-rgb"></part-ref>一个核横跨 R、G、B 三张图，27 个权重一起训练。
t.en: The <part-ref to="lrn-rgb"></part-ref> in the tray spans the R, G and B images with one kernel, its 27 weights trained together.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：只描出蓝与黄的交界，只是变亮变暗的地方要是 0。要想的问题：黄色和蓝色，在三张图里各是什么样？
t.en: Your task: trace only the border between blue and yellow; places that just get brighter or darker must be 0. Something to think about: what do yellow and blue each look like in the three images?

caption.zh: 第一组：天和沙，一条平线
caption.en: Set 1: sky and sand, a level line

brief.zh: 输入是一张彩色风景，从 R、G、B 出口可以分别读取三个通道。只描出蓝与黄交界处的边，只是变亮变暗的地方输出 0。
brief.en: The input is a colour landscape; its R, G and B outputs provide the separate channels. Trace only the edges where blue meets yellow; output 0 where things only get brighter or darker.

hint.zh: 黄色的光，是哪两种颜色的光加起来的？ 训练时可以先给每个通道减去 0.5，让数据围绕 0 分布。
hint.en: Yellow light is made of which two colours of light added together? For training, you can first subtract 0.5 from each channel to centre the data around zero.
